name: pi-router-pintar
description: Fork of beettlle/pi-smart-router (Translate: pi-router-pintar). Auto-model router middleware for pi. Adds reliable loop-escalation failure detection via is_error/status and classifies gpt-5.5+ as frontier-cloud.
